title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #16

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a difference between a condition and a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. A condition is before the prayer, a pillar is inside it
   B. They are the same
   C. A pillar is before prayer
   D. A condition is inside prayer

2. What is our response to Allah's mercy? (1 mark)
   A. Be merciful to people, animals and the environment
   B. Ignore others
   C. Be proud
   D. Be harsh

3. "Ya Sami', hear my dua." Which name is used? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Malik
   B. Ar-Rahim
   C. Al-Basir
   D. As-Sami'

4. What does Surah Al-Ikhlas teach us most? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer is not needed
   B. Wealth saves people
   C. Allah is One and has no equal
   D. We should fight our neighbours

5. How many verses does Surah Al-Fatiha have? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 7

6. Why is it bad when children are made to beg? (1 mark)
   A. It makes them strong
   B. They miss school and face danger
   C. They learn a lot
   D. It helps them study

7. What is patience? (1 mark)
   A. Staying calm and trusting Allah in hardship
   B. Giving up
   C. Complaining
   D. Getting angry

8. What does haya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Modesty
   C. Anger
   D. Speed

9. What can someone say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Astaghfirullah only
   C. Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
   D. Allahu Akbar

10. What does "Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Praise Allah
   B. My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small
   C. Say He is Allah
   D. Guide us to the straight path

11. What is fair play? (1 mark)
   A. Winning at all costs
   B. Keeping the rules and not cheating
   C. Ignoring the referee
   D. Insulting opponents

12. What is a benefit of saying Bismillah? (1 mark)
   A. It makes food free
   B. It stops hunger forever
   C. It brings blessing to the food
   D. It cooks the food

13. What do we say at the end of a dua? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. Nothing
   C. Amin
   D. Bismillah

14. Why do we say the dua for leaving home? (1 mark)
   A. To seek Allah's protection
   B. To pass time
   C. To be loud
   D. To be fashionable

15. Which skill helps keep a person safe near water? (1 mark)
   A. Archery
   B. Chess
   C. Singing
   D. Swimming

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. List the first four pillars of swalah. (4 marks)

17. How does the name Al-Malik help us to use our belongings wisely? (3 marks)

18. State the hadith of eating that is in your syllabus. (2 marks)

19. Write the meaning of the first two verses of Surah Al-Alaq. (2 marks)

20. Distinguish between a nabi and a rasul. (2 marks)

21. What are angels created from, and what do they never do? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A condition is before the prayer, a pillar is inside it
   Conditions before, pillars inside.

2. A — Be merciful to people, animals and the environment
   Mercy received should be shown.

3. D — As-Sami'
   Sami' means All-Hearing.

4. C — Allah is One and has no equal
   The surah declares the oneness of Allah.

5. D — 7
   Al-Fatiha has seven verses.

6. B — They miss school and face danger
   Children should be protected.

7. A — Staying calm and trusting Allah in hardship
   Patience is steady calm.

8. B — Modesty
   Haya is modesty or shyness from wrong.

9. C — Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
   The Prophet taught this for one who forgets.

10. B — My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small
   That is the meaning.

11. B — Keeping the rules and not cheating
   Fair play means honesty in sport.

12. C — It brings blessing to the food
   We ask Allah to bless it.

13. C — Amin
   Amin means "O Allah, accept".

14. A — To seek Allah's protection
   We ask for protection.

15. D — Swimming
   Swimming can save lives.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Niyyah, qiyam, takbiratul ihram, and reciting Al-Fatiha.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Everything belongs to Allah, so we should use what we have responsibly, share and be thankful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Allah as Owner, 1 mark for responsible use, 1 mark for sharing or gratitude.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Mention the name of Allah, eat with your right hand, and eat what is directly in front of you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first two teachings and 1 mark for the third, or 1 mark each for correct halves.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Read in the name of your Lord who created; He created man from a clinging clot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verse.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A nabi is a prophet who receives revelation; a rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: They are created from light and they never disobey Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.
